gloss: whisky and water; a drink diluted with water

definitions.gloss: whisky and water; a drink diluted with water
definitions.explanation: An alcoholic drink, typically whisky or shochu, mixed with water. One of the most common ways to drink spirits in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦ウイスキー→ウイスキー：00412_uisukii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水割|みずわ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: I'll have a whisky and water, please.

examples.japanese: ⟦{焼酎|しょうちゅう}→焼酎：19874_shouchuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{水割|みずわ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like to drink shochu diluted with water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{氷|こおり}→氷：02753_koori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧{水割|みずわ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{格別|かくべつ}→格別：00154_kakubetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧おいしい。
examples.english: On a hot day, a water-diluted drink with plenty of ice is exceptionally delicious.

notes:
USAGE:
{水割|みずわ}り is formed from ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ (water) + ⟦{割|わ}る→割る：02334_waru⟧ (to dilute). The pattern ～{割|わ}り is used for various dilution methods: ⟦{炭酸|たんさん}{割|わ}り→炭酸割り：16637_tansanwari⟧ (with soda water), ⟦お{湯割|ゆわ}り→お湯割り：28103_oyuwari⟧ (with hot water).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ウイスキー→ウイスキー：00412_uisukii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水割|みずわ}り (whisky and water)
- ⟦{焼酎|しょうちゅう}→焼酎：19874_shouchuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水割|みずわ}り (shochu with water)
- {水割|みずわ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to make a mizuwari)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, {水割|みずわ}り is one of the standard ways to order spirits at bars and izakaya, alongside ⟦ロック→ロック：08116_rokku⟧ (on the rocks), ⟦ストレート→ストレート：11630_sutoreeto⟧ (neat), and ⟦お{湯割|ゆわ}り→お湯割り：28103_oyuwari⟧ (with hot water).
